title: Emend conversation event
description: One line of a `.emend/conversations/<conversation-id>/<author>-<device-id>.jsonl` append-only event log (FR-CONV-8; TD-4 amended #94). `conversations.md` beside this file documents the layout, the file naming and each event type. The visible conversation is the fold of every log in the directory, in the order TD-4 amended #94 gives in `docs/tech-design.md`. `parent_id` names the last event the writing device had seen in this conversation, so two events sharing a `parent_id` are a divergence point. `parent_id` is null only for `conversation_created`. An unrecognized `type` still validates, because the fold skips unknown event types (test-plan P5); a known `type` is checked for its fields.

id.description: Globally unique, minted by the writer (UUID/ULID). For `conversation_created`, this id is not the conversation id; the directory name is.

parent_id.description: The last event of this conversation the writing device had seen when it wrote this one. Null only for `conversation_created`.

author.description: Who acted: the person's author value (TD-4's comment-log value) for an act the person took, `agent` for `agent_reply`, and `emend` for a fact the app records.

device.description: The writing device's id, the same id the log's file name carries.

timestamp.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, stamped by the writing device's own clock. Cross-device clock skew is expected; the fold orders by (timestamp, id) with buffer-until-parent, never by file or line order.

document_uuid.description: The `docs.json` UUID of the document this conversation belongs to. Null for a Workshop conversation, and for a document conversation whose document has no identity yet (an untitled document).

origin.description: Present only on a document conversation born from a run of another conversation (FR-CONV-5): that conversation and run.

text.description: The author's message text, exactly as sent.

run_id.description: The run this turn started. Absent only on a turn converted by migration, whose run no longer exists.

unsaved_sent.description: Present when the turn sent unsaved document text (FR-CHAT-4, J13): one entry per document whose unsaved text was sent. Never the text itself.

document_uuid.description: Null for an untitled document with no identity yet.

text.description: The exact summary text sent, after any edit the author made (FR-CONV-6).

run_id.description: The run that received the handoff.
Absent only on a reply converted by migration.

changed_documents.description: The `docs.json` UUIDs of the documents the run changed.

home_conversation_id.description: Present only on the link Emend writes into a changed document's conversation when the run belongs to another conversation (FR-CONV-3): the run's own conversation.
